## Key findings
- No price information was extracted from any source, including Metropolis which provided extensive service details but omitted the test cost.
- Home collection service is mentioned by Metropolis, but without pricing details.
- All other platforms (1mg, Netmeds, Thyrocare, PharmEasy, Google Maps, Practo, JustDial) returned no relevant test data.

## Watch out for
- Without price data, cost comparison is not possible.
- Absence of TSH type information means you cannot determine if an ultrasensitive assay is offered.

## Recommendation
Insufficient information is available to recommend a specific provider for the Thyroid Profile in Koramangala. Consider contacting labs directly (e.g., Metropolis) to obtain pricing and service details.
